Samantha —

Thanks — appreciate the clear asks. High-level answers up front, and I've looped in Neha (Head of Customer Success) to confirm operational details and attach templates.

- TAM coverage: Standard TAM coverage is business-hours (Mon-Fri, 8am-6pm local) with a single on-call escalation path for P1s outside those hours. 24x7 dedicated TAM coverage is available as an add-on (separate SKU).
- Escalation paths: We use a four-severity model (P1–P4). Typical ack times: P1: 15 min, P2: 1 hour, P3: 4 hours, P4: next business day.
- Incident comms: We provide a P1 immediate notification + hourly updates via agreed channel, and a 72-hour preliminary incident summary, followed by a postmortem within 10 business days.
- Evidence/controls: SOC 2 summary and evidence access is handled via our security portal / DocuSign for restricted artifacts — I'll include a link.

Neha — can you confirm the on-call rota example and attach: 1) one-page contact list (CSV/Drive link), 2) P1/P2 templates, and 3) a short sample on-call schedule. Stephanie — can you confirm the commercial note re: 24x7 TAM add-on and a one-time onboarding retainer if Horizon wants expanded coverage?

I can deliver a consolidated one-pager and links by 2028-11-01 EOD. If you prefer a quick call next week to walk the procurement team through the flow, happy to schedule.

Jordan / Stephanie —

Drafting the artifacts now. Confirming operational details below for the one-pager and templates (I will attach the CSV and two template docs in the consolidated packet):

TAM coverage (standard):
- Primary TAM: Business hours, M-F 08:00–18:00 (customer local time).
- After-hours escalation: on-call escalation pool (rotating SRE/eng) with primary ack SLA described below.
- 24x7 TAM: available as add-on; includes named TAM + guaranteed 60-minute on-call response for P1s.

Severity definitions & target ack times (our standard):
- P1 (Platform Down / Critical data loss): Acknowledge 15 minutes, initial mitigation update 30 minutes, engineering engagement within 60 minutes.
- P2 (Degraded — major feature unavailable): Acknowledge 1 hour, mitigation updates every 2 hours, engineering engagement within 4 hours.
- P3 (Partial impact / intermittent): Acknowledge 4 hours, resolution target varies by root cause.
- P4 (Informational / minor): Acknowledge next business day.

Notification cadence & channels:
- Initial P1 notification: email + phone call to primary TAM and on-call SRE; follow-up updates hourly via agreed Slack channel or email if customer prefers.
- P2: initial email + Slack; updates every 2 hours until mitigated.
- Post-incident: 72-hour preliminary report, full postmortem within 10 business days.

Contacts & escalation matrix:
- TAM (primary): [Named TAM – redwood contact] (we will provide as CSV).
- Escalation Engineer (on-call): rotation contact (phone + pager).
- Director Escalation: email to director-esc@redwood.com (for contractual SLA exceptions).

Evidence access:
- SOC 2 summary: available immediately; restricted artifacts via DocuSign access request (link provided in the final packet).
- Audit logs & retention: standard retention is 90 days for raw request logs; longer-term retention arrangements available via contract.

I'll attach tam_oncall_schedule.csv and two templates: P1_notification_template.txt and P2_update_template.txt in the consolidated file.

-Neha

1) Slack as escalation channel:
- Yes, Slack is treated as an official escalation channel if mutually agreed and configured during onboarding. For SLA measurement, an incident reported in Slack will be treated equivalent to email/phone for ack time purposes so long as the dedicated channel is monitored and escalation hooks are active. We recommend a dedicated private channel between Horizon TAM + on-call SRE for P1 communications.

2) Retention for logs:
- Standard: 90 days for raw request logs. We can offer 12-month retention as an optional contract addendum. Commercial: estimated additional storage & compliance cost ~ $8,000/mo for Horizon’s projected volume (we will firm pricing after a short usage profile assessment).

3) SOC 2 artifacts and DocuSign:
- SOC 2 summary is attached in the security portal. For restricted artifacts, we use a DocuSign-based evidence access request: https://docusign.net/DocuSignEnvelope/HZN-2028-019. Horizon signs the access request and we grant time-limited access to the secured folder.
